informed_count_change_plan.current_contract: ReadMeta requires the expected format version and both strict counts. TryParseCount rejects absent/empty strings and values that fail invariant Int64 parsing with NumberStyles.None; parsed counts must be nonnegative. Stored zero is valid and distinct from missing.
informed_count_change_plan.representative_path: ReadMeta returns Nothing on invalid counts; QueryCacheCore returns IncompleteCacheResult before ResolvePolicy. QueryCache removes cache files only for error results marked incomplete after its read scope unwinds. QueryViewport falls through toward build/preparing only when the incomplete cache file is absent; source/setting/zoom/failure-cache guards still apply. ResolvePolicy supplies the prepared counts and override to FileLayerZoomPolicy.Resolve.
